scripts.dev:api: node scripts/env.mjs npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/env.mjs npm run web -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: ENV_FILE=.env.test node scripts/env.mjs npm test -w backend
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/env.mjs prisma migrate deploy --schema database/prisma/schema.prisma
